description: SERL smart meter data of GB EPCs, Rural EPCs and rural archetypes is a data set deposited in bl.notts by its authors Samir Soares. Part of the PhD thesis The challenges of decarbonising heating of rural UK homes by Samir Soares. This PhD is funded by the Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council (EPSRC) through the EPSRC Centre for Doctoral Training in Sustainable Hydrogen (EP/S023909/1). Coverage: national (GB); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
